name: jcv-evals
description: Eval set del asistente de IA de Jalisco Cómo Vamos

scripts.coverage: python3 evals/scripts/coverage.py --base-only > evals/results/coverage_before.md && python3 evals/scripts/coverage.py > evals/results/coverage_after.md
scripts.eval:smoke: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -t evals/smoke.csv --repeat 1 -o evals/results/smoke.json
scripts.eval:baseline: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --repeat 3 -o evals/results/baseline.json && python3 evals/scripts/report.py evals/results/baseline.json > evals/results/baseline.md
